source_domain: Nonzero active sector of the filled tetrahedron, A=2J, J^2=-I
same_carrier_conditions: z=M*x with an independently specified injective map on the active sector
Calibrated subsystem energy E=z^T*G*z/2 with removed baseline
required_independent_certificates: Readout function, phase/sign reference and primitive period ratio rho
Absolute amplitude map or physical support law fixing a independently of the action target
Joint intervals E, T_read, rho and a with a_lower>0
Frozen estimator and non-constructor review before empirical scoring
matrix_extraction_if_absolute_map_certif: For LM=I, check KM=M(LKM), LKM=gamma*A, M^TGM=lambda*I with gamma,lambda>0; tau0=1/gamma and A0=lambda/(2*gamma)

interval.assumptions: All lower bounds positive and intervals jointly certified

failure_modes: Quadratic nonconstant readout has rho=1/2; signed state readout has rho=1
Conserved energy alone supplies no recurrence clock
Unit ray normalization alone supplies no physical support calibration
